parsed.notes: Lens B review only; no support or quote-fidelity defects were raised.

reasons: The lake identity record matches the asserted case name, court, year, docket, and date decided.
The lake citation record contains the asserted official citation, parallel citations, and vendor-neutral citation.
residual_risks: The disclosed treatment record does not independently verify current live-law status; that risk is handled in the treatment assertion.

reasons: Support/holding accuracy is outside Lens B, so I raise no support finding.
No disclosed treatment or progeny edge contradicts treating this as the historical case holding.
residual_risks: Current good-law status for using the holding as live doctrine is not machine-verified in the disclosed lake record.

reasons: Home-role support is outside Lens B, so I raise no support finding.
The role is framed as historical/origin, which does not itself assert a current good-law treatment conclusion.
residual_risks: The disclosed lake record does not independently validate the home-role taxonomy.

defect.evidence_quote: Frontier stub: treatment/progeny intentionally not derived until S6 promotion.
defect.locator_note: content_page.md frontmatter treatment and Treatment & subsequent history section
defect.problem: The structured treatment fields say treatment is unverified, but the built page's treatment discussion makes affirmative current-treatment claims such as 'not overruled' and that the doctrine 'governs today.' The disclosed lake record has no derived treatment, no as-of dates, no treatment edges, and no progeny enumeration to support those claims.
defect.proposed_fix: Remove or qualify the affirmative good-law statements until treatment/progeny is derived. Render only that treatment is unverified/under review, or add a completed current-treatment source before saying not overruled or governs today.

reasons: Lake treatment.field_i_validity is unverified, composite_basis is unverified, and both as_of_content and as_of_treatment are null.
Lake treatment.edges is empty and progeny enumeration is null with rows_cached 0, so the disclosed record cannot verify 'not overruled' or 'governs today.'
residual_risks: The case may in fact remain good law, but that cannot be confirmed from the disclosed evidence.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use 'Treatment unverified; historical doctrinal antecedent pending promotion' instead of an affirmative not-overruled/current-governing label.

reasons: The lake identity record identifies the court as U.S. and court_level as scotus.
The authority_weight label is an institutional weight label and matches the disclosed SCOTUS identity.
residual_risks: Because treatment is unverified, the binding-weight label should not be read as a verified good-law/current-treatment judgment.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep the unverified treatment badge adjacent to the SCOTUS weight label.
